title: Pentagon launches GenAI.mil with Gemini for Government and agentic workflows
summary: The Defense Department launched GenAI.mil, a standalone site giving military personnel, civilian employees and contractors access to generative AI, with Google Cloud's Gemini for Government as its first capability; access requires a department common access card and all tools on the site are treated as controlled unclassified information. The department said Gemini for Government will use intelligent agentic workflows, described as AI processes that make decisions and take actions with minimal human involvement, for deep research, document formatting and video or imagery analysis, and promised free training for all department employees.
verification_note: URL fetched 2026-10-17. Military Times article by Stephen Losey dated Dec 9, 2025 confirms the GenAI.mil launch, Gemini for Government as the first tool, common-access-card gated access, CUI treatment, the department's description of agentic workflows, and free training. The page carries no statistics or user counts; the agentic component is announced by the department, not independently demonstrated.
